name: Review cost follows the latest group and matches the agent trace
description: Read the seeded Run all total, check page scrolling, and verify the same General Reviewer cost in Timeline, Review runs and the trace. Uses a freshly seeded local stack without model calls.

steps.label: load the pull request list
land on Pull Requests
latest review group shows the combined cost
switch the list to a short window
the document stays within the viewport while the workspace scrolls
switch the list to a narrow window
the Cost column remains reachable
restore the wide list

the PR detail tabs are visible
open the Agent runs tab

cmd: div:has(> button[aria-label='Open run trace & logs for General Reviewer']) data[value='0.06']
steps.label: timeline shows the General Reviewer cost
the review run price is visible
the review run header matches the timeline price

cmd: Open run trace & logs for General Reviewer
steps.label: open the General Reviewer trace
the traced run includes the Cost stat
the drawer matches the timeline price
switch to a narrow window
the cost remains reachable in the narrow drawer
restore the wide window
